subject: general
concept: Awards and Honours, Art and Culture
question: Who among the following musicians won the ‘Best Contemporary World Music Album – Global Drum Project’ in the year 2008?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Zakir Hussain**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• For his collaboration effort **"Global Drum Project," tabla maestro Zakir Hussain **won in the Contemporary** World Music Album category**.
 
• For the album, Hussain collaborated with Mickey Hart of the "Grateful Dead," Nigerian drummer Sikiru Adepoju, and Puerto Rican jazz percussionist Giovanni Hidalgo.
 
• **"Global Drum Project" **is Hart and Hussain's second collaboration, following their compilation "Planet Drum," which won the first-ever Grammy Award in the World Music category in 1991.
 
• **The Grammy Award for Best Global Music Album** is given to recording artists for globally influential music at the Grammy Awards, which were first held in 1958 and were originally known as the Gramophone Awards.
 
• **Ustad Zakir Hussain** is a tabla master, composer, percussionist, music producer, and film actor from India.
 
• **President Abdul Kalam honoured him **with the Padma Shri in 1988 and the Padma Bhushan in 2002 from the Government of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Sivamani **is an Indian percussionist, music director, and professional drummer who goes by the stage name **Drums Sivamani**. In 2008 and 2010, he drummed during the IPL Championships.
 
• **Ustad Allarakha Qureshi,** also known as Alla Rakha, was a Hindustani classical music tabla musician from India.
